name: alirezarezvani/claude-skills
hook: 30.6k-star mega-collection of 434 Claude Code skills and plugins. This week: new Agent Launcher pack (6 skills that build, launch, grade, and schedule Claude Managed Agents in your own account) and Video Studio (4 skills that produce MP4 videos from a brief via code-based animatics). Install command verified.
recurring_note: ↑ Day 5 — Agent Launcher (Managed Agents) and Video Studio added

name: modelcontextprotocol/experimental-ext-skills
hook: Official MCP Skills extension reference implementation (SEP-2640), maintained by the Skills Over MCP Working Group. 840 stars. Provides TypeScript types, JSON Schema 2020-12, and machine-verified spec examples — the canonical starting point for any MCP server author wanting their tools to ship bundled skills to Claude Code 2.1.332+ and VS Code.

name: zhuyansen/awesome-claude-video-skills
hook: 2.9k-star curated list of 561 open-source skills and toolkits that let Claude Code and other coding agents make video — frameworks, promo/demos, explainers, shorts, motion graphics, avatars, and music videos, each security-graded. Maintainers ran 16 skills on the same 15-second promo brief in a sandboxed Opus 5.5 session; they recommend explainroo for speed and onetake for single-idea films.
install: See README for individual skill installs

name: travisjneuman/.claude
hook: Drop-in ~/.claude config with 183 skills, 10 agents, 29 commands, 7 hooks, and 86 marketplace repos. November 2026 release added a skills-only plugin path so you can install just domain bundles without hooks and settings; guard hooks now cover PowerShell; long skills split into leaner overviews backed by references/ files. MIT, no telemetry.

name: glebis/claude-skills
hook: 416-star curated collection of 100+ agent skills covering meetings (Fathom/Granola/Zoom), research (Firecrawl/Obsidian), media (GPT Image/ElevenLabs TTS), dev workflows, and business ops. Latest batch adds kinetic-ad (vertical kinetic-type video ads), sops-mesh (cross-machine SOPS secrets sharing), pii-pdf (local PDF PII detection and redaction), bridgework (stack audit + tool canvas), luma-event, and app-map.
install: claude plugin marketplace add glebis/claude-skills && claude plugin install tdd@glebis-skills

name: anthropics/skills — incoming PRs
hook: Three PRs open in the official Anthropic skills repo as of Nov 26: PR #1703 adds md2video-audio (converts Markdown to narrated MP4 videos via Marp slide rendering); PR #1615 adds scnet-hpc (high-performance computing workflows); PR #1771 adds proofcore-contract-auditor (smart contract security analysis). All pending merge review.
install: See README for each skill once merged

name: WaziriG/skill-drops — November 2026
hook: November newsletter release with three standalone Claude Code skills: Session Audit (/session-audit) saves decisions and open items so they persist past session end; Clear the Mac (/clear-the-mac) moves large folders to two external drives and verifies every file before deleting originals; Concept Motion (/concept-motion) turns an idea into a short animated diagram series (~10 min first-run setup).
install: Copy skill folder into ~/.claude/skills/ and restart Claude Code

name: rdmgator12/awesome-claude-plugins
hook: Community-maintained CC0 directory of all 535 official Anthropic Claude plugins, updated Nov 22 with a net +12 additions. New entries include Claude for Manufacturing, a KYC operations bundle, Cortex AppSec, Opsera DevSecOps, AWS Continuum, and RingCentral. 331 plugins run in Claude Code and 468 in Cowork; each entry shows categories, install commands, and Anthropic-verified badges.
